messages.content: 神舟八号的宇航员是谁

function.name: calculate_tax
function.description: Computes the tax for a given income amount, considering various deductions and tax rates based on filing status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

income.description: The total income amount in dollars for which the tax is to be calculated. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The filing status of the taxpayer.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions in dollars the taxpayer is claiming. Defaults to 0 if not provided. This is a float type value.

exemptions.description: The number of exemptions the taxpayer is claiming, typically one per dependent. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

tax_year.description: The tax year for which the calculation is made. Defaults to the current year if not specified.

message.content: 神舟八号（Shenzhou‑8）是中国的一次无人试验飞行，主要用于测试对接系统。由于它是一次无载人试验，所以没有宇航员参与这次任务。
message.reasoning:
The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew members of Shenzhou 8 mission. We need to answer. According to known data, Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight mission launched in 2008. It had a test flight with a robotic spacecraft and a manned test flight? Actually Shenzhou 8 was a test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, but it was unmanned? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 29 September 2008. It was the first test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft's docking system. It was unmanned. So there were no astronauts. But maybe the question expects "Shenzhou 8 had no astronauts because it was an unmanned test flight." So answer: No astronauts; it was unmanned.

Thus we respond accordingly.
